UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: User account and profile for cross-device authentication and access control.

password.description: Hashed or secret auth token for AEG user

email.description: Google email or personal email address

Portfolio.title: Portfolio
Portfolio.description: Comprehensive user financial portfolio storing cars, properties, businesses, bank accounts, and simulation state.

simulatedMonth.description: Current month index in the timeline

data.description: Serialized JSON string or embedded structured portfolio state

SystemSettings.title: SystemSettings
SystemSettings.description: Global economic parameters including interest rates and depreciation benchmarks.

updatedBy.description: Email of master admin who updated settings

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: P2P instant message, photo share, or financial asset spec shared between users.

sharedData.description: Embedded vehicle, property, business, or wire transfer data

MoneyTransfer.title: MoneyTransfer
MoneyTransfer.description: Direct bank wire transfer between registered user accounts.

PayoutRecord.title: PayoutRecord
PayoutRecord.description: Automated monthly net profit background payout record and payment gateway transfer status.

totalRevenue.description: Sum of all monthly business, rental, salary, and dividend revenues

totalExpenses.description: Sum of all monthly business overheads, loans, and recurring expenses

carriedLossDeducted.description: Loss carryover offset from previous unprofitable months

netPayoutAmount.description: Exact profit transferred via payment gateway (0 if loss or break-even)

newLossCarryover.description: Unrecovered net loss carried forward to next cycle

status.description: Lifecycle status of the background payout execution

stripeConnectedAccountId.description: Stripe Connect custom or express account ID

idempotencyKey.description: Cryptographic idempotency key preventing duplicate payouts

failureReason.description: Error details if gateway payout fails

breakdown.description: Detailed itemized breakdown of revenues and expenses

/users/{userId}.description: Registered user accounts for AEG and Google users.

/portfolios/{username}.description: User portfolios and timeline simulation models.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Direct chat messages and shared assets between users.

/transfers/{transferId}.description: P2P bank money transfers and settlement receipts.

/payouts/{payoutId}.description: Automated monthly net profit background payouts and payment gateway transaction logs.

/system_settings/{settingId}.description: Global economic and master administrative configurations.
